footer.tagline: Continuous offensive security. Live evidence only.

home.kicker: One Command Center · live probes · zero simulation
home.lead: Weissman continuously probes your authorized attack surface with production engines — every finding mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, scored, and ready for a signed pull request verified in a sandbox before it ships.
home.pulse_unavailable: Live roster unreachable — we do not invent the number.
home.why_title: Not four platforms glued by acquisition. One system.
home.why_lead: Palo Alto sells Strata, Cortex, Prisma, and Idira. CrowdStrike sells SKUs per endpoint. Wiz sells a graph plus a demo. Weissman is a single Command Center: live engines, live evidence, closed-loop remediation.
home.layers_title: Every layer of the attack surface. Same console.
home.cta_band_title: The website is the door. The system is inside.
home.cta_band_lead: Sign in from the same origin. No buried customer-login footer.

offensive.title: Web & API
offensive.body: XSS, SQLi, SSRF, BOLA, GraphQL, smuggling — real probes against live services you authorize.

cloud.title: Cloud & Kubernetes
cloud.body: AWS, Azure, GCP, IAM paths, admission control, registry signing — evidence from live APIs.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: Kerberos, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, password-spray with RoE gates — protocol exchanges, not guesses.

ot.title: OT / ICS
ot.body: Modbus, DNP3, EtherNet/IP, IEC 61850, S7 — actual frames on authorized industrial ranges.

ai.title: AI / LLM red team
ai.body: Jailbreaks, prompt injection, RAG poisoning — against the models you actually run.

remediation.title: Auto-remediation
remediation.body: Confirmed issues open a signed PR, verified in a throwaway sandbox, then merge.

1.title: Onboard a target
1.body: Client + scope. Out-of-bounds probes are rejected before a packet leaves.

2.title: Continuous scanning
2.body: Orchestrator runs production engines on your cadence. Findings dedupe by signature.

3.title: Triage with proof
3.body: Evidence drawer, MITRE, CVSS, compliance impact. Mark false positive — the engine learns.

4.title: Fix or alert
4.body: Critical verified findings open a PR or fire Slack/Teams. Patch is sandbox-checked first.
